Test fixtures

- `trail_half_marathon.json.gz`, `ski_tour.json.gz`: public recorded Komoot tours, coordinates anonymised by a
  longitude shift (distances and elevation unchanged), with Komoot's own totals for comparison.
- `garmin_run.fit`: FIT recording from the python-fitparse test suite
  (https://github.com/dtcooper/python-fitparse, MIT licence).
